title: ailanthus glandulosa var. sutchuenensis
intro: Ailanthus glandulosa var. sutchuenensis, commonly known as Chinese Tree of Heaven, is a plant species in the Simaroubaceae family. This plant is used in traditional Chinese medicine, valued for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Ailanthus glandulosa var. sutchuenensis include treating fever, digestive issues, and respiratory problems, due in part to its bioactive constituents such as ailanthone and other triterpenoids. However, more research is needed to confirm the full extent of its health benefits and the specific effects of its bioactive constituents.
